description: Header file defining the QuicArenaScopedPtr class, a smart pointer for managing objects potentially allocated in an arena, with custom ownership semantics and support for arena-based memory management.

classes.name: quic::QuicArenaScopedPtr
classes.description: A unique_ptr-style smart pointer that manages objects which may originate from an arena, supporting custom destruction and ownership semantics.

methods.name: QuicArenaScopedPtr
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the pointer to nullptr.

methods.name: QuicArenaScopedPtr
methods.description: Constructor that takes a raw pointer to manage.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Move assignment operator supporting move semantics from another QuicArenaScopedPtr of possibly different type.

methods.name: operator*
methods.description: Dereference operator to access the pointed-to object.

methods.name: operator->
methods.description: Member access operator to access the pointed-to object.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps the managed objects between two QuicArenaScopedPtr instances.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Replaces the managed object, invoking destructor if necessary.

methods.name: is_from_arena
methods.description: Checks if the pointer originated from an arena.

methods.description: Private constructor used internally to create a pointer with explicit arena or heap origin.
